title: Tool Discovery Failure Causing MCP Server Crash in Local Development Environment
body:
**Bug Description**
In the latest version of Claude Code, MCP servers I have developed locally - that used to work just fine with Claude Code - are now failing to find tools. And whenever this happens, it completely breaks Claude Code (ctrl-C required to terminate the process.)
